a_before_b.rationale: Identifying scalability bottlenecks in evaluation is not required to meaningfully understand how to evaluate all system components, as component evaluation can be learned independently of scalability constraints.

b_before_a.rationale: Evaluating all system components is not required to understand scalability bottlenecks in evaluation, since bottlenecks can be identified through cost, time, and annotation issues without first mastering component-level evaluation.
